Package index

Find data

gcd_datasets()
List the datasets in the catalog
gcd_search()
Search the catalog

Understand a dataset

gcd_describe()
Describe a dataset or lookup table
gcd_columns()
Get a dataset's column dictionary
gcd_contract()
Get a dataset's data contract

Get data

gcd_rows()
Get rows of a dataset
gcd_values()
List the category combinations a filter covers

Lookup tables

gcd_dimension()
Get the rows of a lookup table

Geography and school zones

gcd_school_zones()
Get school attendance zones
gcd_district_boundaries()
Get school district boundaries
gcd_school_zone_status()
Get each school's attendance-zone status
gcd_school_zone_coverage()
Get each district's attendance-zone coverage
gcd_locate()
Locate points or addresses

Utilities

gcd_meta()
Get the metadata carried by a result
gcd_citation()
Cite a dataset
gcd_cache_clear()
Clear the session cache and the disk cache
